sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Game over state - check current board and see if I can continue
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Check block colors
block_colors = []
for n in nodes:
    min_row = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
    min_col = min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
    if 48 <= min_row <= 62 and 22 <= min_col <= 40:
        center_row = sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
        center_col = sum(p[1] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
        block_colors.append((n['color'], n['pixels'], center_row, center_col))

print("Right grid blocks:")
for bc in sorted(block_colors, key=lambda x: (x[2], x[3])):
    print(f"  color={bc[0]}, pixels={bc[1]}, center=({bc[2]:.1f}, {bc[3]:.1f})")

# Check handle position
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("\nBar area:")
for i in range(17, 25):
    if i < len(ascii_lines):
        print(f"Row {i}: {ascii_lines[i][20:55]}")

# Try an action to see if game is still interactive
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 50, 'col': 25}])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
